description:
Summary:

Currently during aoti autotune, tensors are deleted after their last kernel autotune. In some models, all the accumulated live tensors (probably from embeddings?) result in required memory > 96GB of 1 h100 device = oom.

Fix:
Each kernel allocates fresh tensors via generate_example_value(), runs,
then immediately dels all tensors. Shared tensors are re-allocated for
each consumer instead of reusing across kernels.

Guard with a new flag aot_inductor.autotune_per_kernel_alloc .

Test Plan: 'aot_inductor.autotune_per_kernel_alloc': True

Reviewed By: desertfire, jansel, jeanschmidt

Differential Revision: D101660133
